notes: The app no longer stores or uses an AI API key: any page on the same web address could read it. The coach, the live mock interviewer and grading now run only through Claude Code on your Mac (or AI is off).
A key saved by an older version is deleted the first time this version opens, on every device.
Profile › AI no longer has a key field, and the coach's photo button is gone (photos needed a key).

Reels now look like Instagram Reels everywhere: the picture fills the screen, the title and caption sit at the bottom left, Save, Speed and Voice are icons on the right, and a round play button shows when a reel is paused.
Opening Reels shows the player straight away with a short 'Getting your reels ready' state instead of a bare 'Loading reels…' line.
1045 of 1255 reels now play in the natural Heart voice.
